name: diag_pilot50_measured_plan_01
command:
import hashlib,json,math,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
def ref(p): return {'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
p=Path('results/smoke_e2e_pilot_engineering_T4_01.json');r=json.loads(p.read_bytes());m=r['metrics']
assert r['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and m['engineering_smoke_completed'] and m['actual_completed_updates']==1 and not m['errors'] and not m['cleanup_errors']
u=m['updates'][0]['total_seconds'];h=m['holdout_evaluations'][0]['seconds'];duration=r['_meta']['duration_sec']
fixed=duration-u-h; baseline50=fixed+50*u+4*h; baseline5=fixed+5*u
budget=json.load(open('logs/review/diag_pilot_budget_after709803_01/report.json'));old=budget['subbudgets']['E2Epilot']['actual_charged_gpu_hours'];assert budget['subbudgets']['E2Epilot']['reserved_charged_gpu_hours']==0
forecast=old+(2*baseline50+baseline5)/3600;assert 6<forecast<9
driver=math.ceil(fixed+1.3*50*u+4*h);wall=driver+64;assert driver==13111 and wall==13175 and old+2*wall/3600<=9
qualified=ref('results/smoke_e2e_pilot_pool_83_certificates_01.json')
holdout=json.load(open('results/train_holdout_freeze.json'))['metrics']['frozen_holdout']
plans={}
for arm in ('T0','T4'):
 argv=['python3','experiments/e2e_certificates83_one_update.py','--direct-arm',arm,'--train-name','smoke_e2e_pilot_'+arm+'_s0_01','--qualified-result-json',json.dumps(qualified),'--holdout-reference-json',json.dumps(holdout),'--train-seconds',str(driver)]
 plan=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(argv,text=True));assert plan['walltime']=='03:39:35' and '--engineering-smoke' not in plan['training_argv']
 assert not plan['population_rebuilt'] and not plan['holdout_refrozen'] and plan['critic_offload'] is False
 plans[arm]=plan
report={'scope':'Engineering planning only, not measured50-update results. T0/T2 speed unmeasured; T4 first-update proxy, no reduced steps or method changes. Abort bounds add30percent to repeated update work, retain measured fixed/holdout overhead, plus original64s cleanup/record reserve; not30percent on entire allocation. T2 cannot be queued concurrently at full reservations and waits for actual completed-cost release.','measured_source':ref(p),'existing_cost_source':ref('logs/review/diag_pilot_budget_after709803_01/report.json'),'actual_prior_gpu_hours':old,'measured_driver_seconds':duration,'measured_update_seconds':u,'measured_holdout_seconds':h,'inferred_fixed_overhead_seconds':fixed,'planning_T0_T4_each50_seconds':baseline50,'planning_T2_five_seconds':baseline5,'planning_total_gpu_hours_including_actual_prior':forecast,'activated_authorized_cap_gpu_hours':9,'each_driver_stop_bound_seconds':driver,'each_pbs_wall_seconds':wall,'actual_plus_two_full_reservations_gpu_hours':old+2*wall/3600,'plans':plans}
out=Path('logs/review/diag_pilot50_measured_plan_01');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False,parents=True);path=out/'report.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('PILOT_PLANNING_JSON: '+json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='plans'},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
print('PLAN_REFERENCE: '+json.dumps(ref(path)),flush=True)
